AutoComplete.description: Free text with suggestions, where the typed value is valid even if it matches nothing; use Select when the value must come from the list.

Breadcrumb.description: The trail back up the hierarchy above the current page.

Button.description: The action control; `type` sets its weight and `danger` marks a destructive action, which are two separate props in Ant and are often confused.

Calendar.description: A full month or year view for browsing dates in place; use DatePicker to capture a date in a form.

Card.description: A bounded surface grouping one subject with an optional title and actions.

Carousel.description: Rotating panels; reach for it only where the content is genuinely equivalent, since anything past the first panel is rarely seen.

props.name: showArrow
props.description: default behavior, you can hide it by setting `suffixIcon` to null.

Cascader.description: Selects a value from a strict hierarchy, one level at a time; use TreeSelect when the tree is browsable rather than sequential.

Checkbox.description: An independent on/off choice applied on submit; use Switch when the change takes effect immediately.

Collapse.description: Sections that reveal on demand; use Tabs when the sections are peers a user switches between rather than optional detail.

props.name: size
props.description: Note: `default` is deprecated and will be removed in v7, please use `medium` instead.

Descriptions.description: Read-only label and value pairs for one record; use Form for anything editable.

Divider.description: The one hairline rule between content; reach for spacing before a divider.

Drawer.description: A panel from a screen edge for secondary work that keeps the page behind it visible; use Modal when the page must be blocked.

Dropdown.description: A menu of actions opened from a control; use Popover for arbitrary content and Tooltip for a label.

Empty.description: What a region shows when there is nothing in it; the first thing a new user sees and the state most often left out.

Flex.description: One-direction layout with a gap; the default for arranging things, with Space reserved for inline runs of controls.

FloatButton.description: An action floating above the page; more than one group on a screen means none of them is primary.

Form.description: Ant's form controller: layout, validation and submission together. Fields belong to it rather than holding their own state.

Image.description: An image with a preview overlay and fallback; a plain img is enough where neither is wanted.

Input.description: Single-line text entry; inside a Form it takes its label, validation and error text from Form.Item rather than from itself.

InputNumber.description: Numeric entry with steppers and bounds; use Slider when the approximate position matters more than the exact number.

List.description: A vertical run of items of one kind; use Table when the items have columns worth comparing.

Mentions.description: Multi-line text that offers suggestions after a trigger character.

Menu.description: Navigation between destinations, vertical or horizontal; use Dropdown for a short list of actions on a control.

Modal.description: A blocking window for a task that interrupts the page; use Drawer when the page behind should stay visible.

Pagination.description: Page navigation for a known total; when the total is unknown, load more instead.

Popconfirm.description: A small inline confirmation anchored to the control that triggered it; use Modal when the decision needs explanation or more than two options.

Popover.description: An anchored surface holding arbitrary content on click; use Tooltip for a label and Dropdown for a list of actions.

Progress.description: Advance toward completion; use Spin for a wait whose length is unknown and Skeleton when the shape of the result is known.

Radio.description: One option where exactly one may be chosen; use Segmented when the choice also switches what is shown.

Rate.description: A star-scale input or display for a subjective score.

Result.description: The outcome of an operation filling a region — success, failure, or a missing page — with the next action attached.

props.name: block
props.description: Option to fit width to its parent's width

props.name: size
props.description: Option to control the display size

Segmented.description: A compact one-of-many switch; use Tabs when panels are revealed and Radio when the choice is a form value.

Select.description: A choice from a fixed list; use AutoComplete when a typed value that matches nothing is still valid.

Skeleton.description: Holds the shape of content that has not arrived; use Spin when the shape is unknown.

Slider.description: A value from a range where the position matters more than the number.

Space.description: Even spacing between inline elements; use Flex for anything with alignment or wrapping to decide.

props.name: wrapperClassName

props.name: indicator

props.name: fullscreen

Spin.description: An indeterminate wait; use Progress when the advance is measurable.

Splitter.description: Resizable panes with a draggable divider.

props.name: maxCount
props.description: Maximum number of step items to display (`>= 3`).

props.name: offset
props.description: Set offset cell, only work when `type` is `inline`.

Steps.description: Progress through an ordered task; use Tabs when the sections can be visited in any order.

Switch.description: An immediate on/off setting; use Checkbox when the change only lands on submit.

Table.description: Rows with comparable columns, sorting and selection; use List when there are no columns to compare and Descriptions for a single record.

Tabs.description: Switches between peer panels; use Segmented when the choice sets a value and reveals nothing.

Tag.description: A standalone label for a category or state, optionally closable; use Badge for a count attached to something else.

TimePicker.description: Captures a time of day; pairs with DatePicker where both are needed.

Timeline.description: Ordered events along an axis; use Steps when the user is moving through them rather than reading them.

Tooltip.description: Short text on hover or focus; it must never hold anything the user has to interact with.

Typography.description: Applies the type scale to text, with copyable, ellipsis and editable behaviours; a screen setting its own font size is bypassing the scale.
